title: Financial Analyst
why_fit: 1-2 yr analyst role built on reconciliations, variance work and budget models that mirror his AMG reporting and recovery work.
why_us: CertiK's finance team asks for someone who reconciles bank, revenue and crypto balances, chases down variances and helps with budget and forecast models. That is close to what I do at AMG Family Dental, where I reconcile accounts, run budget-vs-actual variance analysis and found more than $500K a year in revenue we were not capturing. I like that this role also looks for process automation, since I work in advanced Excel and Python. Finance at a Web3 security company is new territory for me, and I would be glad to learn the crypto side.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Analyst role on CertiK's finance team. The description centers on reconciliations, variance investigation, and supporting budgets and forecasts, which is the core of my current job.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, I direct financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, run budget-vs-actual variance analysis, and prepare KPI reports for ownership. When I tightened our financial reporting and reconciliation, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue, and I reduced A/R aging by 10%. Both results came from the same habit CertiK describes: tie out every balance and keep digging until the discrepancy has a cause.

Before AMG, I was a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, where I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls and worked in SAP. That taught me to document work so someone else can follow it, which matters for month-end close support.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis University and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk University. My toolset includes advanced Excel, SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy), and I would like to apply it to the process automation your posting mentions. I have not worked with crypto balances before, but reconciling a new asset type follows the same logic as any other ledger, and I am ready to learn it quickly.

I am a U.S. citizen, fluent in English and Armenian, and available immediately. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
